channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: Five policemen trapped on TN mountain rescued
item.description: The cops who had gone to nab a history sheeter apparently could not descend from the hill in Kadayam as the terrain became slippery due to rain.

item.title: Root remains unbeaten on 138 as England dismissed for 334 on Day 2 of the 2nd Ashes test
item.description: Starc, who returned 6-75 from 20 overs to increase his series haul to 16 wickets, had the visitors reeling at 5-2 in the third over of the match.

item.title: States must work towards a Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat: Annpurna Devi
item.description: Devi pointed out the government’s sustained interventions, which have contributed to an improved sex ratio at birth, increased girls’ enrolment in education, and overall empowerment of women and girls.

item.title: CPM questions Palaniswami’s stand on Thiruparankundram issue
item.description: On Thursday, Palaniswami issued a statement accusing the DMK government of failing to implement the Madras High Court’s single-judge order relating to the lighting of the lamp at the peak of the Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai.

item.title: Thiruparankundram row: Police book TN BJP chief, 112 others
item.description: They were booked for disturbing public peace, among others.

item.title: Film producer settles dispute with Ilayaraja by paying Rs 50 lakh for using his songs
item.description: Recording the joint memorandum of compromise, dated November 28, 2025, Justice Senthilkumar Ramamoorthy of Madras High Court, in his recent order, closed the application arising out of a suit filed by Illaiyaraja.

item.title: IndiGo disruptions worsen; over 400 flights cancelled, passengers stranded for long hours
item.description: Airports witnessed chaotic scenes as some IndiGo flights faced delays of more than 12 hours, many passengers staged protests and some complained of misplaced baggage.

item.title: A supersized World Cup field begins taking shape at Friday's draw
item.description: Led by captain Lionel Messi, who turns 39 during the tournament, Argentina seeks to become the first nation to win consecutive World Cups since Brazil in 1958 and 1962.

item.title: Director Vysakh on Mammootty: Some actors don't just act, they evolve!
item.description: The director, who wished Mammootty all the very best for 'Kalamkaval', said, "May this film become another shining chapter in his legendary journey."

item.title: Lok Sabha adjourns till 12 noon amid DMK members' protests over Deepam row
item.description: The DMK-led Tamil Nadu government has moved the Supreme Court against a Madras High Court order permitting devotees of the Arulmighu Subramaniya Swamy Temple to light traditional 'Karthigai Deepam lamp' at 'Deepathoon', a stone lamp pillar located on the Thiruparankundram hillock close to a dargah.
